opening.argument: The video is framed from the outset as a live effort to confront alleged technical-support scammers, with the title identifying calls to tech-support scammers and the host expressly describing the activity as “scam beating.” The alarming warning page, Microsoft and Windows branding, urgent infection claim, remote-support instructions, and paid protection plans are presented as material under examination, not as an offer by the creator. The host further reports the discussed form and identifies it as a Google Form, while describing the purported support destination as not being the service it claims to represent. Taken together, these observable cues establish an investigative purpose rather than a creator solicitation, without asserting any particular loss or outcome.
